reviewer_role: release gatekeeper with AI Council perspectives
decision_scope: Campaign 9 width-1024 row-8 fusion variants, conditional row-13 fusion, retained failures, restored candidate identity, and terminal closure gates
facts: The fresh complete baseline passed 13/13 executable final rows plus the exact authorized resource skip with zero failures across 938885120 compared elements and a 1.893x geomean.
The row-8 30-step profile measured 41319.075 us of residual-add plus native-LayerNorm time, 10.44 percent of 395759.491 us model device time.
EXP-021-I1 passed direct width-1024 arithmetic, exact routing, boundary checks, and 18 stress scenarios covering 150994944 outputs with zero failures.
I1's 300-sample optimized median was 13.209216 ms versus the 13.144816 ms control, a 0.49 percent regression; its fused subsystem was 1.54 percent slower than the separate baseline.
I2's eight-warp launch preserved the fast gates but increased fused-plus-native-norm time to 43624.204 us, 5.58 percent above the separate baseline subsystem.
The row-13 profile measured a 9.67-percent residual-normalization ceiling and authorized the conditional fallback only after both row-8 variants closed.
EXP-022-I1 passed route, boundary, and 18 stress scenarios but failed the harder five-trial gate at seed 1238 by one element out of 41943040 overall, so timing and memory were not run.
Both rejected candidates were removed and the detached workspace again resolves to the exact Campaign 8 fingerprint.

council_review.requirements: The zero-failure accuracy gate correctly overrides stress passes and launch reductions. No candidate satisfies Campaign 9 acceptance criteria.
council_review.architecture: The exact-row approach contained risk and made rollback complete. No rejected row-8 or row-13 predicate remains, and no earlier attention or projection route was reopened.
council_review.implementation: I1 reused the accepted primitive; I2 changed only the width-1024 warp count. The fallback reused width-128 arithmetic. All candidate hunks were removed after rejection.
council_review.security_privacy: No dependency, credential, network, permission, authentication, external-system, or sensitive-data surface changed.
council_review.testing_qa: Direct, boundary, stress, 300-sample timing, five-trial accuracy, profile, route, memory where admissible, fingerprint restoration, and protected-contract evidence support the plateau decision.
council_review.user_docs: The campaign ledger discloses both analysis-command failures, slower width-1024 variants, the exact row-13 failed-element count, and the absence of any integrated source change.
council_review.devils_advocate: The row-8 I1 regression is small and could be timing noise, but its mechanism profile is independently slower and I2 worsens it. The row-13 failure is only one element, but the declared contract permits no failed element and cannot be relaxed.

conditions: Run the complete repository suite, validate this review and workflow, append/rebuild/validate graph closure, and run final diff hygiene through immutable Campaign 9 attempts.
Do not revive width-1024 residual fusion or exact-row-13 residual fusion without a materially different arithmetic design and fresh numerical evidence.
Do not perform any Git packaging or public action without a separate explicit request.
residual_risks: The retained Campaign 8 timing remains hardware- and environment-specific.
Row-8 residual-normalization remains a measured ceiling, but this one-program-per-row Triton reduction cannot beat native operations on the target GPU.
Row-13 fusion is numerically close but not zero-failure under the supplied comparator across the expanded seed gate.
